title: 第0011章 修炼术法火球术第0012章 上交灵米周通的震惊
slug: 五灵根修炼慢我有百倍灵药空间

陆青禾没有想到还有这样的东西。
他问道：“请问师兄，这种灵水在什么地方有？”
黄盖微微一笑，拿出一个绿色小瓶。
“为兄这里正好有一瓶，如果师弟需要我可以均给师弟。”
看着黄盖手中的绿瓶，陆青禾虽然好奇灵水到底有没有黄盖说的这样神奇，但是他知道天下没有白吃的午餐。
陆青禾问道：“师兄不可能平白无故的将灵水给师弟吧？”
黄盖点头道：“没错，这灵水珍贵无比，师弟需要支付一枚灵石。”
听到一枚灵石，陆青禾放弃了，灵石他刚好有一枚，可是没必要购买这还不知道有没有作用的灵水。
更何况这灵田灵力已经枯竭，哪怕是灵水真的有作用，也不过是饮鸩止渴，需要海量的灵石来购买灵水。
陆青禾面露遗憾的表情：“我是很需要这样的灵水，但是我拿不出一枚灵石，等到师弟弄来灵石，一定找师兄购买的。”
黄盖眉头一皱，他没有想到陆青禾竟然一枚灵石都拿不出来。
但是看陆青禾不像说谎的模样，也是满脸的可惜，看来这单生意是做不成了。
他也是靠着这样的方法获得灵石购买修炼资源。
确定陆青禾没有灵石，黄盖不做停留：“叨唠师弟了，我的灵田在距离师弟五公里之外，师弟有需要可以到那里来找我。”
陆青禾保证：“等到有灵石，师弟一定会去找师兄的。”
黄盖点点头，转身离开了，不知道是不是去找下一块灵田的主人去了。
看黄盖离开的背影，陆青禾松了口气，并不是事务殿派来的人。
不过陆青禾决定以后修炼要小心一点，在附近距离他不远的地方有着其他的五块灵田。
现在陆青禾只是希望在上交灵米之前没有其他的麻烦出现。

等到上交灵田，就立刻远离事务殿，那周通就算是天大的本事，也很难在数千的杂役之中找到自己。
陆青禾也想过离开太玄宗，到外面获取修炼资源。
但是想要离开宗门，两种办法，一种是十年之期，每一个入宗的弟子十年有一次回家的机会。
其次是成为外门弟子，向宗门报备就可以离开了。
同时陆青禾心底也有一个想法，那就是获得一门术法的修炼，一个修士没有术法，是无法发挥出修仙者真正的实力。
在太玄宗杂役弟子想要获得术法，一个是靠宗门的功德点到功法殿兑换，一个是使用灵石购买。
第二个月，陆青禾换了一个模样再次出现在了杂役交流区。
这次他冒险的拿出百斤灵米，不然根本很难兑换到修炼的术法。
百斤灵米，顿时引起杂役弟子的轰动。
百斤灵米，按照市场价，那可是十块灵石，对杂役弟子来说是一笔无法想象的财富。
陆青禾写下自己需要兑换的物品，两种能够修炼的术法。
一名炼气二层的修士走了出来，对着陆青禾见礼：“见过师兄。”
不用展露实力，能够拿出百斤灵米的修士，必定是炼气三层。
陆青禾点点头，对着炼气二层修士问道：“师弟有术法要兑换灵米？”
炼气二层修士反问：“不知道师兄需要何种属性的术法？”

Lu Qinghe didn't expect such a thing.
He asked: "Excuse me, senior brother, where can I find this kind of spiritual water?"
Huang Gai smiled slightly and took out a green vial.
"Brother, there happens to be a bottle here. If junior brother needs it, I can give both to junior brother."
Looking at the green bottle in Huang Gai's hand, Lu Qinghe was curious whether the spiritual water was as magical as Huang Gai said, but he knew that there was no such thing as a free lunch.
Lu Qinghe asked: "It's impossible for senior brother to give spiritual water to junior brother for no reason, right?"
Huang Gai nodded and said: "Yes, this spiritual water is extremely precious. Junior brother needs to pay a spiritual stone."
Lu Qinghe gave up when he heard about a spiritual stone. He happened to have one spiritual stone, but there was no need to buy the spiritual water, which he didn't know if it had any effect.
What's more, the spiritual power of this spiritual field has been exhausted. Even if the spiritual water is really effective, it is just drinking poison to quench thirst. A large amount of spiritual stones are needed to buy the spiritual water.
Lu Qinghe had a regretful expression on his face: "I really need this kind of spiritual water, but I can't get a single spiritual stone. When I get the spiritual stone, I will definitely buy it from my senior brother."
Huang Gai frowned. He didn't expect that Lu Qinghe couldn't even take out a single spirit stone.
But Lu Qinghe didn't look like he was lying, and his face was full of pity. It seemed that this business could not be done.
He also relied on this method to obtain spiritual stones and purchase cultivation resources.
After confirming that Lu Qinghe did not have a spiritual stone, Huang Gai did not stop: "Junior Brother Nao Nao, my spiritual field is five kilometers away from Junior Brother. Junior Brother can come to me there if you need it."
Lu Qinghe promised: "When there is a spirit stone, junior brother will definitely go to senior brother."
Huang Gai nodded, turned around and left, wondering if he was going to find the owner of the next spiritual field.
Seeing Huang Gai's leaving figure, Lu Qinghe breathed a sigh of relief. He was not someone sent by the Affairs Hall.
However, Lu Qinghe decided to be more careful in his future cultivation. There were five other spiritual fields nearby not far from him.
Now Lu Qinghe just hopes that there will be no other troubles before handing over the spirit rice.
When he handed over the spiritual field, he immediately stayed away from the affairs hall. Even if Zhou Tong was extremely capable, it would be difficult for him to find himself among the thousands of servants.
Lu Qinghe also thought about leaving Taixuan Sect and obtaining cultivation resources outside.
But if you want to leave the sect, there are two ways. One is a ten-year period. Every disciple who joins the sect has a chance to go home once every ten years.
The second is to become an outer disciple, report to the sect and then leave.
At the same time, Lu Qinghe also had an idea in his heart, that is, to obtain the training of a magic method. A monk without magic skills would not be able to exert the true strength of an immortal cultivator.
In the Taixuan Sect, if the handyman disciples want to obtain spells, one can rely on the sect's merit points to redeem them at the Kung Fu Hall, and the other can use spiritual stones to purchase them.
In the second month, Lu Qinghe appeared again in the handyman exchange area with a different appearance.
This time he took a risk and took out a hundred kilograms of spiritual rice, otherwise it would be difficult to redeem the techniques for practice.
One hundred kilograms of spiritual rice immediately caused a sensation among the handyman disciples.
One hundred kilograms of spiritual rice, according to the market price, is worth ten spiritual stones, which is an unimaginable wealth for the handyman disciples.
Lu Qinghe wrote down the items he needed to exchange, two techniques that could be practiced.
A monk from the second level of Qi Refining came out and saluted Lu Qinghe: "I've met senior brother."
A monk who can produce a hundred kilograms of spiritual rice without showing off his strength must be at the third level of Qi Refining.
Lu Qinghe nodded and asked the second-level Qi Refining monk, "Junior brother, do you have any skills that you want to exchange for spiritual rice?"
The second-level Qi Refining monk asked back: "I wonder what kind of magic technique does Senior Brother need?"
